summary: Attach multiple free-form tags to an alert (new Tag entity, many-to-many join table/migration), add/remove tag endpoints, tag query filter on GET /api/alerts, Tags included in AlertResponse.
scope_anchors: Alert entity + new Tag entity many-to-many
IAlertRepository / AlertRepository: tag filter + tag mutation
adjacent_dependencies: database/01_CreateDatabase.sql and database/02_AlertServiceDb_Migrations.sql (idempotent script alternative to EF migration)
constraints: Max 10 tags per alert; each tag 1-30 chars; dedupe case-insensitively
404 if alert or tag assignment doesn't exist on DELETE
No AutoMapper - manual mapping only in AlertMappingExtensions.cs
Follow existing nullable/not-found service-return convention (UpdateAsync/DeactivateAsync/DeleteAsync pattern)
New join table must follow database-standards.md naming (PK_, FK_, IX_, 3NF)
No existing custom-exception-to-4xx convention; max-10-tags 400 surfacing is an implementation-time decision
validation_commands: dotnet ef migrations add AddTagsAndAlertTags --project AlertService.Data.SQL --startup-project AlertService.API
dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent --project AlertService.Data.SQL --startup-project AlertService.API --output database/02_AlertServiceDb_Migrations.sql
coverage_goals: behavior coverage: add tags (including dedupe/limit/length validation), remove tag (including 404 cases), GET filter by tag, response includes tags
resolved_decisions: POST /api/alerts/{id}/tags returns 200 OK with the updated AlertResponse (mutates existing resource, not a new addressable one)
Max-10-tags violation surfaced as 400 via new TagLimitExceededException caught locally in AlertsController.AddTags; global ExceptionHandlingMiddleware left unchanged
